mainEntity.name: What are the common costs associated with implementing AEO for a pest control business?

acceptedAnswer.text: The costs associated with AEO implementation for a pest control business typically involve content creation and optimization. This can include expenses for hiring content writers to develop detailed FAQs, blog posts, and service page descriptions. There may also be costs for a digital marketing specialist or agency to conduct keyword research, analyze competitor's answer content, implement structured data (schema markup), and monitor performance. The overall investment depends on the scale of your content needs and whether you handle it in-house or outsource.
acceptedAnswer.description: AEO costs usually cover content creation (writers for FAQs, blogs) and optimization (specialists for keyword research, schema markup, performance monitoring), varying by scope and whether done in-house or outsourced.
